meta.note: Sommelier-picked ordinal sets: 12 distinct line/category colors per math-viz theme, tuned to each theme's tone and energy. ordinal[0]=theme primary, ordinal[1]=theme accent where possible. Light themes use deeper saturated hues for contrast on paper; dark themes use bright luminous hues for glow on void. Order maximizes neighbor distinctness.

mathviz-arctic-ice.energy: surgical ice-white precision, monochrome calm, frosted glass, hairline borders — frosted pastel ordinals, low-chroma icy tints, no competing neon

mathviz-clean-teal.energy: clean light geometry, clinical paper-and-teal, 03-lineage chips and toggles — teal-led balanced clinical hues, deeper saturation for contrast on white

mathviz-educational-warm.energy: friendly warm-paper education, approachable indigo parabola + coral tangent — warm-friendly distinct hues, readable on cream paper

mathviz-midnight-violet.energy: observatory cosmic depth, neon violet curves on midnight navy, magenta highlights — cosmic brights anchored violet/magenta, ice labels

mathviz-sage-editorial.energy: calm print editorial, serif display, paper whites with sage mids — muted ink-like earthy ordinals plus one slate neutral for other/total

mathviz-tron-cyan.energy: tron arcade void, neon cyan bloom with amber tangent glow, direct 05 lineage — high-saturation luminous neons that glow on black void
